notes: §1985:IX.4.5.3 SR1: 'The storage area associated with identifier-1 and the record area associated with file-name-1 must not be the same storage area.' MoveBinder.BindIntoPhrase calls StatementValidation.CheckIntoReceiver, which asks CheckPhraseOperandIsNotRecordArea (RecordAreaRule.InForce: below 2023) whether StorageSharing.IsRecordAreaOf the operand: a record of the file or of a SAME RECORD AREA peer, or an offset-0 full-length subordinate; COBOL6827. Probes at 85 on an indexed file: refused INTO IREC (sequential, random, dynamic READ NEXT and READ KEY IS), INTO a second 01 of the FD, INTO a 10-byte subordinate WHOLE, INTO a SAME RECORD AREA peer's record; accepted INTO a part (IKEY), another file's record, a WS item and an ODO group (FS 47 after the failed OPEN, INTO untouched) - a part only shares storage (§1985:VI.6.4.5), right. 2002 refuses, 2023 accepts (c). The gap: IsRecordAreaOf excludes every reference-modified operand (docs/FILES_DESIGN.md D31 b), so READ IFILE INTO IREC (1:10) and INTO WHOLE (1:10), which name exactly the record area's 10 positions, compile. kb/Work PB5412 holds the defect (code read: coderead-85/out-read3/rd-08.json). || RE-VERDICTED CONFORMS (kb/Work PB5412, wave 20262025 group B): StorageSharing.IsRecordAreaOf decides 'the same storage area' on the storage the operand denotes (StorageExtent.OfReference), not on its form, so a literal reference modification of the whole record (R (1:10); R (1:) whatever R's length), the element of a table of one occurrence and a 66 THROUGH alias of the whole record are refused COBOL6827, and a SAME AREA peer's record is the area too (1985:VII.2.13.4 GR1, FileModel.StorageSharingFiles); docs/FILES_DESIGN.md D31(b) is revised. The read-3 and read-4 probes are all refused now.

next.reason: 1985: "The storage area associated with identifier-1 and the record area associated with file-name-1 must not be the same storage area."; 2023: "14.6.10, Overlapping operands, and 14.9.25, MOVE statement, General rules, apply to any cases in which the storage area identified by identifier-1". 1985 refuses a program whose INTO item is the record area. 2023 has no such syntax rule; shared storage is handled by the overlapping-operand and MOVE rules, so the result may be undefined.
